info.name: Worldline Card Issuing Account - AccountState Authorization API

params.name: acquirerId
params.description: Unique identification of the acquirer, determined by equensWorldline

params.name: acquirerRefNo
params.description:
Data supplied by an acquirer to assist in identifying an authorization.
(Note: acquirerRefNo = acquirerReferenceNumber)

examples ARN29851, 74875009071000046650752

params.name: transactionAmountFrom
params.description: Transaction amount (whole units), amount should be greater than or equal to this value

params.name: transactionAmountTo
params.description: Transaction amount (whole units), amount should be less than this value

params.name: transactionAmountCurrency
params.description: Transaction amount currency, according to ISO 4217. Required if search amount is available. Example EUR

items.docs:
This operation uses the unique AcquirerRefNo (acquirerReferenceNumber ARN) to retrieve the associated authorization(s) data. 
If there is a previous and/or next page the http response header will have a link (url) to this data. See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Headers/Link#pagination_through_links
